condition_validation_gate: Only if development has condition candidates; validation selects among development candidates and is not final testing.
successor_gate: Freeze Common selected guard if supported, otherwise actual locally supported original P1; with neither support do not run.
source_selection: Fixed seeds registered before public-prefix responses; no hidden-parameter screening and no removal of a successful old Program.

frozen_predictor_library: 48 prior versions for every phase; new development exports kept at source and excluded from transfer for method attribution.
